subject: Evidence request: attestation for training, background checks, and offboard custody chain
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@trustaudit.co>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: AuditOps <auditops@trustaudit.co>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: training and personnel lifecycle artifacts for SOC 2 readiness

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of the SOC 2 preparatory review we need to validate personnel controls covering: required security training completion, background check confirmations (redacted PII), and offboarding/access termination proof for leavers between 2024-01-01 and 2026-09-30.

Could you please provide:
- A roster export that shows training completion dates and modules taken (CSV preferred)
- Redacted background-check confirmations or attestation that checks were performed and compliance team redacted PII (PDF)
- Access cutover/offboard logs showing deprovisioning timestamps and the SSO/AD accounts terminated (CSV)

Attachment: trustaudit_evidence_scope_v2.docx (our scope and sample templates).

We typically need evidence uploaded to a shared Drive link or a secure SFTP location. What ETA can you give us?

Best,
Elena
Elena Rossi
TrustAudit - SOC & Compliance Team
elena.rossi@trustaudit.co
[Attachment: trustaudit_evidence_scope_v2.docx (DOCX, 72KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@trustaudit.co>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: training and personnel lifecycle artifacts for SOC 2 readiness

Elena — thanks for the clear scope and the template. Looping in Monica (HR ops) to pull the training roster and Markus (Identity infra) to pull the offboard/deprovisioning logs and the BG redaction pack.

Monica / Markus — can you confirm:
1) ETA to get a first-pass package uploaded to the Drive link?
2) Monica — will the training export include module-level completion dates and email identifiers? If not, note what fields we can provide.
3) Markus — can you provide the offboard log and a signed attestation for redacted background checks (we'll attach a signed attestation file).

Target for external delivery: EOB tomorrow (2026-10-23) if feasible. If not, earliest next-day window.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Security & Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@trustaudit.co>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: training and personnel lifecycle artifacts for SOC 2 readiness

Karthik / Elena — I can run the training roster export. A few clarifications:
- Time range: do you want the live hire date + training status for all current employees and contractors between 2024-01-01 and 2026-09-30, or only those who completed training in that window?
- We will include: employee id (internal), work email, role, hire date, training module ids, completion timestamp, and certification flag. We will not include DOB/SSN or PII.

I've attached a sample CSV (training_roster_q3.csv) that mirrors the format I can produce. Where would you prefer us to upload final artifacts? Drive link above works for me; if TrustAudit needs SFTP, confirm and we'll schedule the transfer.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
HR Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: training_roster_q3.csv (CSV, 48KB)]

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@trustaudit.co>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 16:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: training and personnel lifecycle artifacts for SOC 2 readiness

Thanks — uploaded the offboard/access cutover extract and the redacted BG confirmations.

What I uploaded to the Drive folder:
- offboard-access-cutover-2026.csv (includes username, AD/SSO id, deprovision timestamp, terminating manager)
- bg-checks-redacted-2024-2026.pdf (redacted PII; contains check performed date and confirmation ID)
- attestation_signed_klein.pdf (signed attestation confirming redaction and proof custody)

Notes:
- BG source records contain PHI in raw form; we redacted name and SSN fields before export. We recorded redaction steps in the attestation.
- Offboard log includes system names and timestamps; for accounts that were re-used we included comments in the CSV.

If TrustAudit needs S3 access or a secure SFTP push, we can set a one-time token. Otherwise the Drive link should be sufficient for initial review.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Infrastructure & Identity Lead
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: offboard-access-cutover-2026.csv (CSV, 62KB); bg-checks-redacted-2024-2026.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB); attestation_signed_klein.pdf (PDF, 28KB)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@trustaudit.co>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, AuditOps <auditops@trustaudit.co>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request: training and personnel lifecycle artifacts for SOC 2 readiness

Elena — we uploaded the pack to the Drive folder you shared and added a short index (index.txt) summarizing filenames and redaction steps. Quick recap:
- training_roster_q3.csv: module-level completion and timestamps for hires/contractors in scope; email identifiers included.
- bg-checks-redacted-2024-2026.pdf: background check confirmations with PII redacted; stewardship attestation attached (attestation_signed_klein.pdf).
- offboard-access-cutover-2026.csv: deprovision timestamps across SSO/AD systems.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-example-upload (we added a readme and index). Jira ticket SEC-9487 created for tracking follow-ups.

If your team needs the raw database exports for sampling we can coordinate a secure transfer under an NDA/secure channel — please confirm. Otherwise let us know if you need any additional fields or clarifications; we can produce a redaction log and hash manifest for verification.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Security & Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
[Related link: JIRA:SEC-9487]
